name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. Fetched the quickstart page, confirmed the FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the sandbox, and made a working chat completion API call. Verified using both curl and the Python OpenAI SDK method from the docs. The Python script at /home/daytona/fireworks_quickstart.py ran successfully and printed the model's response: "Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed". I listed available models via the API and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/qwen3p7-plus", which worked and returned a valid chat completion. This is the only deviation from the docs.
